items.title_cn: 复发性高甘油三酯性急性胰腺炎：风险分层、代谢易感性与二级预防
items.title_en: Recurrent Hypertriglyceridemic Acute Pancreatitis: Risk Stratification, Metabolic Susceptibility, and Secondary Prevention
items.abstract_cn: 高甘油三酯血症相关急性胰腺炎（HTG-AP）日益常见，尤其是在合并代谢性共病的患者中。其管理不仅限于急性发作期间的降甘油三酯（TG）治疗：临床医生必须确认病因归属、处理可逆性驱动因素、评估个体易感性，并在出院前启动可持续的预防方案。复发反映了纵向TG负荷、代谢和遗传易感性、其他胰腺危险因素以及随访缺口。与侧重于本次住院期间的急性降TG策略不同，二级预防需要对代谢暴露、个体易感性和治疗持久性进行纵向评估。在此我们描述我们的SMART方法，该方法将这些任务组织为：筛查与确认（Screen and confirm）、修正触发因素（Modify triggers）、评估易感性（Assess susceptibility）、降低TG负荷（Reduce TG burden）以及追踪与定制长期管理（Track and tailor long-term management）。
items.abstract_en: Hypertriglyceridemia-associated acute pancreatitis (HTG-AP) is increasingly encountered, particularly among patients with metabolic comorbidities. Management extends beyond triglyceride (TG) lowering during the acute episode: clinicians must confirm etiologic attribution, address reversible drivers, assess individual susceptibility, and initiate a sustainable prevention plan before discharge. Recurrence reflects longitudinal TG burden, metabolic and genetic susceptibility, other pancreatic risk factors, and gaps in follow-up. Unlike acute TG-lowering strategies, which focus on the index hospitalization, secondary prevention requires longitudinal assessment of metabolic exposure, individual susceptibility, and treatment durability. Here we describe our SMART approach, which organizes these tasks as Screen and confirm, Modify triggers, Assess susceptibility, Reduce TG burden, and Track and tailor long-term management.
items.summary_cn: 该论文聚焦高甘油三酯血症相关急性胰腺炎（HTG-AP）的复发问题，提出二级预防需超越急性期降TG，应纵向评估代谢暴露、个体易感性及治疗持续性，并介绍了SMART方法（筛查确认、修正诱因、评估易感性、降低TG负担、追踪并调整长期管理）。

items.title_cn: 感染性假性囊肿和感染性包裹性坏死的升阶梯治疗策略：一项前瞻性观察性研究
items.title_en: Step-up strategy for the treatment of infected pseudocysts and infected walled-off necrosis: a prospective observational study
items.abstract_cn: 背景。感染性假性囊肿和感染性包裹性坏死（WON）是急性胰腺炎的严重并发症，开放手术后死亡率较高（高达35%）。腔道对合金属支架（LAMS）的使用使微创内镜引流成为可能；然而，关于分期内镜下清创过程中实验室炎症标志物动态变化及囊腔消退的数据仍不充分。目的——评估使用LAMS进行透壁引流后行分期内镜下清创和坏死组织清除术在感染性假性囊肿和感染性包裹性坏死患者中的疗效和安全性。方法。一项前瞻性观察性单中心研究于2019年1月至2025年3月开展。共纳入43例感染性假性囊肿或感染性包裹性坏死患者。所有患者均接受超声内镜引导下透壁引流，置入10 mm LAMS，随后对感染性假性囊肿行分期清创，对感染性包裹性坏死行分期坏死组织清除术。主要结局指标为C反应蛋白（CRP）水平和囊腔体积的动态变化。统计分析采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验。结果。中位CRP从入院时的132.7（53.1；190.2）mg/L降至出院时的43.6（14.8；76.1）（p 0.001）。囊腔体积从344.8（88.9；830.2）降至11.2（5.3；16.4）cm³（p 0.001），消退率达94.2%。共记录30例不良事件，其中发热最常见（20例，占所有并发症的66.7%）。危及生命的并发症（囊肿穿孔、侵蚀性出血）需要开腹手术的有5例（11.6%）。死亡率为2.3%。在内镜治疗无效的患者中，初始囊腔体积超过1000 mL，坏死组织块大小超过5 cm。结论。使用LAMS进行内镜透壁引流联合分期清创可有效控制感染性假性囊肿和感染性包裹性坏死患者的炎症，并实现囊腔几乎完全消退。对于囊腔体积 1000 mL且坏死组织块较大（ 5 cm）的病例，应考虑联合引流技术（经皮引流、视频辅助腹膜后清创术）。
items.abstract_en: Background. Infected pseudocysts and infected walled-off necrosis (WON) are severe complications of acute pancreatitis associated with high mortality rates (up to 35%) following open surgery. The use of lumen-apposing metal stents (LAMS) enables minimally invasive endoscopic drainage; however, data on the dynamics of laboratory inflammatory markers and cavity regression during staged endoscopic debridement remain insufficient. Aims — to evaluate the efficacy and safety of transmural drainage using LAMS followed by staged endoscopic debridement and necrosectomy in patients with infected pseudocysts and infected walled-off necrosis. Methods. A prospective observational single-center study was conducted from January 2019 to March 2025. A total of 43 patients with infected pseudocysts or infected walled-off necrosis were enrolled. All patients underwent endoscopic ultrasound-guided transmural drainage with a 10-mm LAMS, followed by staged debridement for infected pseudocysts and staged necrosectomy for infected walled-off necrosis. The primary outcomes were the dynamics of C-reactive protein (CRP) levels and cavity volume. Statistical analysis was performed using the Wilcoxon signed-rank test. Results. Median CRP decreased from 132.7 (53.1; 190.2) mg/L at admission to 43.6 (14.8; 76.1) at discharge (p 0.001). Cavity volume decreased from 344.8 (88.9; 830.2) to 11.2 (5.3; 16.4) cm³ (p 0.001), representing a regression of 94.2%. A total of 30 adverse events were recorded, with hyperthermia being the most common (20 cases, 66.7% of all complications). Life-threatening complications (cyst perforation, erosive bleeding) required laparotomy in 5 patients (11.6%). Mortality was 2.3%. In patients with ineffective endoscopic treatment, the initial cavity volume exceeded 1000 mL and sequestrum size exceeded 5 cm. Conclusions. Endoscopic transmural drainage with LAMS and staged debridement effectively controls inflammation and achieves almost complete cavity regression in patients with infected pseudocysts and infected walled-off necrosis. In cases with cavity volume 1000 mL and large sequestra ( 5 cm), combined drainage techniques (percutaneous drainage, video-assisted retroperitoneal debridement) should be considered.

items.title_cn: C反应蛋白-甘油三酯-葡萄糖指数预测急性胰腺炎严重程度：一项回顾性横断面研究
items.title_en: C-reactive protein–triglyceride–glucose index predicts acute pancreatitis severity: a retrospective cross-sectional study
items.abstract_cn: 目的 早期预测急性胰腺炎（AP）严重程度对于及时干预和改善预后至关重要。C反应蛋白-甘油三酯-葡萄糖指数（CTI）是一种简单、常规实验室衍生的生物标志物。它整合了炎症和胰岛素抵抗（IR）的信号，已在心血管和代谢疾病中显示出预测价值。然而，其与AP严重程度的关联仍不清楚。方法 这项回顾性横断面研究纳入了2019年1月至2026年1月期间入院的AP患者。CTI的计算公式为0.412 × ln（CRP，mg/L）+ ln [甘油三酯（mg/dL）× 空腹血糖（mg/dL）/2]。我们采用Spearman相关性分析、逻辑回归和受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线分析评估了CTI与AP严重程度之间的关联。严重程度根据修订版Atlanta标准（RAC）和改良计算机断层扫描严重程度指数（MCTSI）进行分级。结果 本研究共纳入567例AP患者。在RAC和MCTSI两种分级系统下，高CTI组的重症AP均显著多于低CTI组（均P < 0.001）。Spearman秩相关证实存在正向单调关联（P < 0.001）。在多变量模型中，CTI在RAC（比值比[OR] 1.180，95%置信区间[CI] 1.027–1.357，P = 0.019）和MCTSI（OR 1.436，95% CI 1.237–1.667，P < 0.001）下均可独立预测严重程度。对于MCTSI ≥ 8，ROC曲线下面积（AUC）达到0.763（95% CI 0.681–0.845，P < 0.001）。CTI + 白细胞（WBC）+ 乳酸脱氢酶（LDH）的联合模型在所有终点中产生了最高的AUC（范围0.697–0.795）。结论 CTI可独立预测AP严重程度，具有中等区分准确度。其常规可及性和低成本支持其作为早期风险分层辅助工具的潜力。加入WBC和LDH进一步改善了预测性能，但增量获益有限。
items.abstract_en: Objective Early prediction of acute pancreatitis (AP) severity is essential for timely intervention and improved outcomes. The C-reactive protein–triglyceride–glucose index (CTI) is a simple, routine laboratory-derived biomarker. It integrates signals of inflammation and insulin resistance (IR) and has demonstrated predictive value in cardiovascular and metabolic diseases. However, its association with AP severity remains unknown. Methods This retrospective cross-sectional study included AP patients admitted between January 2019 and January 2026. CTI was calculated as 0.412 × ln (CRP, mg/L) + ln [triglycerides (mg/dL) × fasting glucose (mg/dL)/2]. We assessed the association between CTI and AP severity using Spearman’s correlation, logistic regression, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis. Severity was graded according to both the revised Atlanta criteria (RAC) and the modified computed tomography severity index (MCTSI). Results A total of 567 patients with AP were included in this study. The high CTI group had significantly more severe AP than the low CTI group under both the RAC and MCTSI grading systems (both P < 0.001). Spearman’s rank correlation confirmed a positive monotonic association ( P < 0.001). In multivariate models, CTI independently predicted severity under the RAC (odds ratio [OR] 1.180, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.027–1.357, P = 0.019) and MCTSI (OR 1.436, 95% CI 1.237–1.667, P < 0.001). For MCTSI ≥ 8, the area under the ROC curve (AUC) reached 0.763 (95% CI 0.681–0.845, P < 0.001). The combined model of CTI + white blood cell (WBC) + lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) yielded the highest AUCs across all endpoints (range 0.697–0.795). Conclusion CTI independently predicts AP severity with moderate discriminative accuracy. Its routine availability and low cost support its potential as an adjunct for early risk stratification. Adding WBC and LDH further improved predictive performance, though the incremental benefit was modest.
items.summary_cn: 该回顾性横断面研究纳入567例急性胰腺炎患者，发现C反应蛋白-甘油三酯-葡萄糖指数（CTI）与AP严重程度（按修订Atlanta标准和MCTSI分级）呈正相关，且CTI可独立预测AP严重程度（RAC：OR 1.180；MCTSI：OR 1.436），对MCTSI≥8的AUC达0.763；CTI联合WBC和LDH的模型在所有终点中AUC最高（0.697–0.795）。

items.title_cn: 胆总管结石患者的临床特征——一项观察性研究
items.title_en: Clinical Features of Choledocholithiasis Patients- an Observational Studyeous Fistula Repair: Ligation with Cauterization versus only Ligation in Pediatric Patients
items.abstract_cn: 背景：胆总管结石是一种常见的胆道疾病，由胆总管（CBD）内的结石引起，导致阻塞以及胆管炎和胰腺炎等问题。诊断依赖于临床、实验室和影像学结果，其中内镜逆行胰胆管造影术（ERCP）是主要治疗方法。本研究旨在评估孟加拉国胆总管结石患者的临床特征、实验室结果和结局。方法：一项基于医院的观察性研究于2024年7月至12月在达卡BSMMU进行，纳入80例经临床、实验室和影像学结果确诊为胆总管结石的成年患者。收集有关临床特征、实验室指标、影像学特征、治疗方法和结局的信息，并使用SPSS 25.0版进行分析。已获得伦理委员会批准和知情同意。结果：在80例胆总管结石患者中，平均年龄为49.6 ± 14.1岁，女性比例较高（58.8%）。右上腹疼痛（92.5%）、黄疸（68.8%）和ALP升高（80%）是主要发现。82.5%的患者观察到CBD扩张，而ERCP实现了92.5%的结石清除率，结局良好。较大结石（>10 mm）与急性胆管炎显著相关（p=0.024），凸显了早期诊断和适当管理的重要性。结论：胆总管结石常影响中年女性，表现为右上腹不适、黄疸和肝功能异常。ERCP实现了显著的结石清除，而较大的CBD结石增加了急性胆管炎的风险，凸显了及时诊断和治疗的重要性。Journal of Paediatric Surgeons of Bangladesh (2026) Vol. 17 (2): 76-81
items.abstract_en: Background: Choledocholithiasis is a prevalent biliary condition resulting from stones in the common bile duct (CBD), resulting in blockage and issues like cholangitis and pancreatitis. Diagnosis depends on clinical, laboratory, and imaging results, with endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) being the main treatment. This research sought to evaluate the clinical characteristics, laboratory results, and outcomes of patients with choledocholithiasis in Bangladesh. Methods: An observational study based in a hospital was carried out at BSMMU, Dhaka, from July to December 2024, involving 80 adult patients with confirmed choledocholithiasis diagnosed via clinical, laboratory, and imaging results. Information regarding clinical features, laboratory profiles, imaging traits, treatment methods, and outcomes were gathered and examined utilizing SPSS version 25.0. Approval from an ethics committee and informed consent were secured. Results: In a group of 80 patients with choledocholithiasis, the average age was 49.6 ± 14.1 years, with a higher proportion of females (58.8%). Right upper quadrant pain (92.5%), jaundice (68.8%), and elevated ALP (80%) were the predominant findings. CBD dilatation was observed in 82.5%, while ERCP achieved a 92.5% stone clearance rate with favorable outcomes. Larger stones (>10 mm) were significantly associated with acute cholangitis (p=0.024), highlighting the importance of early diagnosis and appropriate management. Conclusion: Choledocholithiasis frequently impacted middle-aged women and manifested as right upper quadrant discomfort, jaundice, and liver function irregularities. ERCP resulted in significant stone removal, whereas larger CBD stones heightened the risk of acute cholangitis, highlighting the importance of prompt diagnosis and treatment. Journal of Paediatric Surgeons of Bangladesh (2026) Vol. 17 (2): 76-81
items.journal: Journal of Paediatric Surgeons of Bangladesh
items.summary_cn: 该研究对80例胆总管结石患者进行观察，发现右上腹痛（92.5%）、黄疸（68.8%）和ALP升高（80%）为主要表现，CBD扩张占82.5%，ERCP结石清除率达92.5%；大于10mm的结石与急性胆管炎显著相关（p=0.024）。

items.title_cn: 中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞比值预测急性胰腺炎严重程度：系统评价与探索性荟萃分析
items.title_en: Neutrophil-to-Lymphocyte Ratio in Predicting Severity in Acute Pancreatitis: A Systematic Review and Exploratory Meta-Analysis
items.abstract_cn: 背景：早期识别有重症急性胰腺炎（AP）风险的患者在临床上仍然十分重要。中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞比值（NLR）价格低廉、可快速获得，并已被研究作为预后生物标志物，但已报道的阈值、测量时间和目标结局差异很大。方法：使用PubMed/MEDLINE、Google Scholar和Semantic Scholar进行了系统综述，并进行了探索性定量合成。纳入标准为评估成人入院时或住院早期NLR与重症AP、持续性器官衰竭、重症监护入住、胰腺并发症、死亡率或相关不良结局关系的研究。研究根据NLR检测时间、目标结局、暴露定义和效应量进行分组；统计学上不可兼容的估计值未进行合并。结果：在筛选的149条记录中，10项原始研究纳入定性合成，5项为图形化定量合成提供了数值估计。较高的NLR始终与更严重的疾病相关。各研究特异性AUROC为：入院时NLR预测持续性器官衰竭为0.760，48小时NLR预测重症AP为0.785，第0天NLR区分轻症与合并中重症/重症AP为0.998。由于检测时间和目标结局不同，这些估计值未进行合并。关联估计值也保持独立：NLR ≥11与持续性器官衰竭相关（HR 1.37，95% CI 1.00–1.89），NLR ≥10与重度高甘油三酯血症诱导的AP相关（OR 6.71），连续入院NLR与重症AP相关（OR 3.78，95% CI 2.83–5.06）。结论：NLR是早期AP风险分层的实用辅助工具，但当前证据不支持通用阈值或单一合并预后效应。需要使用标准化检测时间和结局进行前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_en: Background: Early identification of patients at risk of severe acute pancreatitis (AP) remains clinically important. The neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) is inexpensive, rapidly available, and has been investigated as a prognostic biomarker, but reported thresholds, measurement times, and target outcomes vary substantially. Methods: A systematic review with exploratory quantitative synthesis was conducted using PubMed/MEDLINE, Google Scholar, and Semantic Scholar. Adult studies evaluating admission or early-hospitalization NLR against severe AP, persistent organ failure, intensive care admission, pancreatic complications, mortality, or related adverse outcomes were eligible. Studies were grouped according to NLR timing, target outcome, exposure definition, and effect measure; statistically incompatible estimates were not pooled. Results: Of 149 records screened, 10 primary studies were included in qualitative synthesis and five contributed numerical estimates to graphical quantitative synthesis. Higher NLR was consistently associated with more severe disease. Study-specific AUROCs were 0.760 for admission NLR predicting persistent organ failure, 0.785 for 48-hour NLR predicting severe AP, and 0.998 for day-0 NLR distinguishing mild from combined moderately severe/severe AP. These estimates were not pooled because timing and target outcomes differed. Association estimates also remained separate: NLR ≥11 was associated with persistent organ failure (HR 1.37, 95% CI 1.00–1.89), NLR ≥10 with severe hypertriglyceridemia-induced AP (OR 6.71), and continuous admission NLR with severe AP (OR 3.78, 95% CI 2.83–5.06). Conclusion: NLR is a practical adjunct for early AP risk stratification, but current evidence does not support a universal threshold or single pooled prognostic effect. Prospective validation using standardized timing and outcomes is required.
items.journal: Journal of Health Wellness and Community Research
items.summary_cn: 该综述纳入10项原始研究，发现较高的NLR与急性胰腺炎更严重的疾病结局一致相关，但各研究在NLR测量时机、阈值和目标结局上差异较大，无法合并为统一的预后效应或通用阈值；例如入院NLR预测持续性器官衰竭的AUROC为0.760，48小时NLR预测重症AP为0.785，NLR≥11与持续性器官衰竭相关（HR 1.37），NLR≥10与重度高甘油三酯血症性AP相关（OR 6.71）。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
